## Summary

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Verification

List the commands or manual checks used to verify the change.

## Related work

Link the issue or OpenSpec change, if applicable.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no credentials, private data, or generated runtime state.
- [ ] Tests and documentation were added or updated where needed.
- [ ] Relevant local checks pass.
- [ ] Behavioral changes are reflected in the relevant OpenSpec artifacts.
- [ ] Compatibility, migration, security, and release implications are described above.
- [ ] Dashboard changes include screenshots when they improve reviewability.
